meta.title: ETHOS · 问道 — From Intent to Bounded Action
meta.subtitle: Target architecture, not a claim of current implementation.

views.label: Challenge and adjudicate
views.note: Research and interpretation propose meaning. Only explicit accepted meaning enters the current carrier.

views.label: Compile explicit inputs
views.note: Commitment, Facts and Plan are transient. Determinism does not certify natural-language understanding.

views.label: Admit only bounded work
views.note: PASS admits this action only. Evidence and a compiled Plan do not authorize shared effects.

views.label: Observe or repair, then re-evaluate
views.note: Unknown facts need observation. A model gap requires the smallest repair. Neither permits a shortcut to work.

cards.title: Understand before compiling
items: Challenge interpretations with source examples. Settle scope, exceptions, assumptions and guarantees; discovery is not complete understanding. Recovered obligations are accepted, superseded, pending verification or rejected. Only accepted meaning enters official OpenSpec; compilation does not certify understanding.

Accepted intent compiles to transient Commitment; fresh Facts and applicable prior Attestations produce a bounded TransitionPlan and proof obligations. Source acceptance, delivery and Change completion are distinct; one active Change retains outstanding tasks until archive. Valid no-spec changes and archive retain proof identity.

cards.title: Authority is a separate judgment
items: Subject, current policy, intent, facts and plan are conjunctive. Only PASS admits action. BLOCK or UNKNOWN does not execute; capability, evidence and coordination grant no permission.

Attestation is the sole durable semantic result, scoped by predicate, bindings, validity and verifier, never permission. Commitment, Facts and Plan are transient. Change relations and experiments are derived: no persistent workflow graph, compatibility residue, feedback ledger or memory-backed truth.
Worktrees prepare and prove independently from exact bases. Fresh prewrite binds actor, lane and current facts; a four-field Lease coordinates, never stores intent or permission.
Required action inputs: Authorized subject; Applicable authority; Compiled Commitment; Fresh observations; TransitionPlan.
Required claim selector: all applicable scoped prior Attestations selected by the current plan and policy.

cards.title: Uncertainty is explicit
items: Contradiction or missing meaning blocks the affected effect. Preserve the counterexample, promote the smallest model boundary and recompile; no exception route around authority.

BLOCK prevents a future effect; UNKNOWN may describe an already attempted effect. Preserve reachable Git and necessary Attestations through actor or host loss. Re-observe uncertain outcomes, recompile and reauthorize before continuation; never replay blindly.
